name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd.
about: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in rail infrastructure works in India and internationally. The company undertakes rail project development and implementation, as well as provides financial resources mobilization services. It also executes various railway projects, including new lines, doubling, gauge conversion, railway electrification, workshops, bridge work, mega and monumental bridges, metro and metropolitan transport projects, new lines, hilly railway projects, construction of cable stayed bridges, institutional buildings, track renewal, training institutes, railway and other safety works, traffic facilities, and road over bridges, etc. In addition, the company engages in civil engineering; equipment and engine; installation of solar energy systems, and electricity transmission and control apparatus; installation and maintenance of underwater telecom

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~32% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~0% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 12.7% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 43 vs sector median 21; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 27, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Profit fell 32% last year, which inflates PE; check whether the drop is cyclical (temporary) or structural.
Since 2023, most of the 15% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 18 → 43), not earnings growth (-10% a year).
